metadata.description: Daniel (Elian-Studio)'s Claude Code plugin marketplace. Ships elian-store (bundled workflow skills, agents, hooks, and skill-owned validators) and elian-workflow (issue-cycle work-history recording to Notion).

plugins.name: elian-store
plugins.description: Workflow bundle with requirements intake, gated design-document generation and change propagation, decision artifacts, TDD implementation flows, engineering and persona review, PR review and drafting, verification orchestration, requirement coverage, the issue cycle recorded to Notion, harness sync, and bundled domain agents.

plugins.name: elian-workflow
plugins.description: DEPRECATED — install elian-store instead, which now ships these two skills alongside the rest of the workflow. Issue-cycle bookends that record work history to Notion: open an issue, then close it with a readable narrative of decisions, architecture, verification, and remaining checks. Kept so existing installs keep working.
